svg.title: Alpha: v0.2.0-alpha1 — read the entire README before use
svg.desc: Not yet tested on live platforms. x264 only; NVIDIA NVENC is not supported yet. Use the Active Live Delay dock, not OBS's normal Start Streaming button.

g.text: ALPHA: v0.2.0-alpha1 — NOT YET TESTED ON LIVE PLATFORMS
READ THE ENTIRE README BEFORE USE
LOCAL TESTS ONLY; TWITCH, YOUTUBE AND KICK UNTESTED

Use the Active Live Delay dock, not OBS Start Streaming.
